author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: You will never lose your identity.
context_before: s. The world came into being, not to make one person more important than the other, but to make individual man into the image of the one and only God.
context_after: You are individualized and the God forming you into his likeness is individualized and is known by name in eternity. Although there are more sons of God than there are sands of the sea, we will all return to know each other intimately. All things by a law divine in one another’s being mingle. We will have access to the wisdom of all, wisdom derived from this fantastic experience of descending into mortal flesh.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Rock (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Then he would awake and we would be one.
context_before: I saw Neville as a breathing, pulsing being. His eyes were closed in deep, deep meditation and I knew he was meditating me. I also knew that when his work was finished, I would be as perfect as he is.
context_after: The perfect Rock is not something out in space, but our redeemer, who is the Lord. We are redeemed by the limit of contraction called “the Rock”. Alth
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Rock (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: I am one of ten children.
context_before: If God has put bounds to the people according to the number of the sons of God, and his sons are clothing themselves in mortal flesh, how can any man stop it?
context_after: We are the result of God’s sons meditation, and no one can stop God’s sons from coming in for the experiment.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Rock (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: And remember: all things are possible to him.
context_before: Dwell upon the fact that you are the perfect son of God. Live in the consciousness of that perfection and one day you will see your face woven into the likeness of the Father in you, who is Jesus Christ.
context_after: Do not turn to anyone on the outside, turn only to the son of God within you who is your human imagination!
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Rock (1969-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: I kill and I make alive.
context_before: No matter what you have done, do not dwell upon it and become remorseful; rather start dwelling upon the perfection of the son of God within you. Dream nobly and have no other foundation, for there is no other God. “See now that I, even I am he and there is no God besides me.
context_after: I wound and I heal, and none can deliver out of my hands. I raise my hand to heaven and cry, ‘I live forever.'”
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Rock (1969-01-01).
